subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the documentation redirects are added, should the stack permanently remove the shipped source-checkout qa-matrix package and Matrix-specific runtime facade, with exact-head dependency authorization?
rationale: The implementation preserves the supported CLI behavior, but repository policy treats removal of plugin/runtime surfaces and dependency graph entries as compatibility-sensitive; automation cannot decide whether any source-checkout consumers must receive a transition period.

options.title: Accept the ownership cutover
options.body: Approve the exact dependency deletion and land after the preceding stack once redirects and current-head checks are complete.

options.title: Preserve a transition surface
options.body: Keep a narrowly documented compatibility package or facade for one release if maintainers know of supported source-checkout consumers.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Leave qa-matrix ownership in place until the stack and external-consumer expectations are clarified.

recommendation.title: Accept the ownership cutover
recommendation.body: Approve the exact dependency deletion and land after the preceding stack once redirects and current-head checks are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Matrix live lane and subsequent qa-matrix ownership boundary that this PR removes.
